briefing: Field Report from Agent Polaris: A significant Medicaid fraud scheme has been uncovered in Minnesota, with an unnamed defendant skipping court and forfeiting bond. The scheme involves $11M in alleged fraud. Additionally, the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme has resulted in 65 convictions, with multiple defendants pleading guilty. The scheme involves allegations of fraud totaling $9B+. The HHS has frozen all child care payments to Minnesota over fraud allegations, suggesting a significant level of fraud has been uncovered. Further investigation into the entities involved and the scope of the fraud is warranted.
